memories.content: Khrushchev is the leader of the Soviet Union. He has authorized the placement of nuclear missiles in Cuba and is now faced with the US quarantine. He is considering his options and may decide to communicate directly with President Kennedy.

On October 22, 1962, President Kennedy announced a quarantine of Cuba to prevent further Soviet shipments of offensive military equipment. The world is on edge as the Cuban Missile Crisis unfolds. Direct communication between the leaders is possible through diplomatic channels.
